propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena symbol tools despite documented guidance because bash is already in-hand and Serena requires an extra ToolSearch discovery round-trip
Serena's LSP index cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), making grep necessary for those cases
A PreToolUse hook on Bash should surface a reminder on every grep invocation, naming both the preferred Serena path and the legitimate string-literal exception case
Project-specific criterion and coaching move should exist to detect incomplete source-code reference enumeration and direct re-derivation via Serena
Serena symbol tools must be non-deferred (no ToolSearch cost) in this repo via .claude/settings.json to eliminate friction asymmetry
AGENTS.md must encode division of labour by use case (who calls/imports -> Serena; string literals -> grep; stale index -> grep) rather than a bare preference
